title: SciFi Futures: How close are science fiction technologies to reality?
excerpt: Technologies from popular science fiction novels, broken down into the real enabling capabilities needed to unlock them, with technology readiness levels, bottlenecks, funding estimates, who is working on each, and how authors' predicted dates compare with reality.
content_html:
What would it take to live in a world with a space elevator like in The Fountains of Paradise by Arthur C. Clarke?
